headline: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard's charts in 2027
summary: YouTube will resume sharing streaming data with Billboard in 2027, ending a major disagreement, after Billboard changed its chart formula to give more weight to free, ad-supported streams.

claims.statement: YouTube will resume sharing streaming data with Billboard in 2027, ending a major disagreement between the two.

sources.quote: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard charts, ending major disagreement
YouTube will once again be part of Billboard chart calculations in 2027

claims.statement: The resumption follows a change to Billboard's chart formula giving more weight to free, ad-supported music streams.

sources.quote: after changes to the chart formula give more weight to free, ad-supported music streams.
Billboard will give more weight to free, ad-supported listening in its methodology.
